observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: Here. While it’s warm.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: Thank you.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: Your hands are still shaking.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: They’ll stop.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: So will mine, if I give them a minute.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: How far to the entrance?

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: Beyond the ridge. There’s some climbing yet.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: I can manage.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: I know. I’m asking you to rest.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: *looks across the valley* There are still people in those houses.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: The carts are going back for another group.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: And when we leave here, we’re going the other way.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: Another surge could take that road. We need to reach the source.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: I wish we could tell them more than ‘we’ll do what we can.’

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: We got the first carts through. They saw that.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: I was thinking about the mill.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: Halden’s?

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: I cleared that little recess and felt as if I’d done something remarkable.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: You cleared the catch so I could work on it. We needed that.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: *a faint smile* You told me that then, too.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: I meant it then, too.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: You didn’t seem nervous.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: I was. It helped having a problem I could understand.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: A broken catch. A branch in the water.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: And two of us to deal with it.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: I wish it were that simple again.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: So do I.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: But we’re going in.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Mira
observed_dialogue.text: When you’re ready.

observed_dialogue.speaker: Caelan
observed_dialogue.text: Give me a moment.
